title: Data license
description: The terms of a DATA SALE — a bonded order whose value-added IS access to records (a dataset, a stream, the books behind settled processes). Composes alongside figaro-commerce (the sale itself) and figaro-content-handoff (the delivery — encrypted-transfer for counterparty-private data); the seller's offer, price, whitelist, and calendar are catalogue and profile concerns, never fields here. Licensed records are self-authenticating when sourceProcesses is set: each disclosed leaf travels with its merkle inclusion proof against that process's on-chain agreementHash, so the licensee verifies provenance against the chain rather than the licensor's word — and the 2× bond replaces pre-inspection, which is what makes pricing data possible without first revealing it. Redistribution cannot be prevented on-chain; the term creates timestamped, co-signed EVIDENCE for the outer recourse layers (co-seller pressure, arbitration forums, ordinary courts), the same posture as every off-chain obligation. The sustainable product is the stream, not the snapshot: a stream licensee who breaches loses the continuing stream. Compose figaro-schedule alongside for time-bounded access windows and figaro-geolocation for territory — those are their clauses' concerns, never fields here.

fields.name: licenseScope
fields.description: What is licensed, named editorially — the dataset, stream, or record family this sale grants access to. The invoice-legible name of the data product.

fields.name: purpose
fields.description: The permitted use, stated as a restriction the licensee co-signs (e.g. internal analytics only, model training excluded). Omit for unrestricted use within the redistribution term.

fields.name: access

valueLabels.snapshot: Snapshot — the records as of delivery

fields.description: snapshot = a one-time delivery of the records as they stand, verified by content hash; stream = continuing access to the growing record, the repeated-game form — each period's delivery is a further bonded order or hand-off under this same agreement's terms.

fields.name: redistribution
fields.description: Whether the licensee may pass the records onward. prohibited is an off-chain obligation: the chain cannot prevent copying, but this co-signed term is the timestamped evidence an outside forum reads.

fields.name: sourceProcesses
fields.description: The settled processes whose records are licensed — provenance anchors. Each disclosed leaf verifies by merkle inclusion proof against the named process's on-chain agreementHash. Omit for data products not anchored to specific processes.
